text: The Patriots head into Sunday's Week 5 matchup against the Raiders significantly shorthanded, with six players ruled out including starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck)—a considerable blow to a secondary facing Kirk Cousins, who has been one of the NFL's most surprising performers early this season. There's a glimmer of good news on the injury front, however, as running back Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice after his absence. On the bright side, the Patriots' edge rusher rotation of Dre'Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder, and rookie Gabe Jacas has exceeded expectations through four games and will carry momentum into the matchup. The team will honor Hall of Famer Adam Vinatieri with an on-field ceremony during halftime, and the Patriots will wear throwback uniforms as part of the league's Week 5 uniform slate.
